# MeshCentral remote desktop client

`agent-desktop.js` is `public/scripts/agent-desktop-0.0.2.js` from MeshCentral 1.3.1
(https://github.com/Ylianst/MeshCentral), unchanged. It's licensed under the Apache
License 2.0; see `LICENSE`. The remote control viewer (`../../control.js`) drives it
over a MeshCentral desktop tunnel.
